import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static class Modular {
        static long MOD = 998244353;
        long value;

        Modular(long v) {
            value = ((v % MOD) + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        Modular add(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular(value + rhs.value);
        }

        Modular sub(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular(value + MOD - rhs.value);
        }

        Modular mul(Modular rhs) {
            return new Modular((value * rhs.value) % MOD);
        }

        Modular div(Modular rhs) {
            return mul(rhs.inverse());
        }

        Modular power(int exp) {
            Modular base = new Modular(value);
            Modular result = new Modular(1);
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    result = result.mul(base);
                }
                base = base.mul(base);
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        Modular inverse() {
            return power((int) (MOD - 2));
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(value);
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_VAL = 10010;
    static Modular[] factorial = new Modular[MAX_VAL];
    static Modular[] invFactorial = new Modular[MAX_VAL];
    static Modular[] inv = new Modular[MAX_VAL];

    static void initFactorials() {
        factorial[0] = new Modular(1);
        for (int i = 1; i < MAX_VAL; i++) {
            factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1].mul(new Modular(i));
        }
        invFactorial[MAX_VAL - 1] = factorial[MAX_VAL - 1].inverse();
        for (int i = MAX_VAL - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFactorial[i] = invFactorial[i + 1].mul(new Modular(i + 1));
        }
        for (int i = MAX_VAL - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
            inv[i] = invFactorial[i].mul(factorial[i - 1]);
        }
    }

    static Modular nCr(int n, int r) {
        return factorial[n].mul(invFactorial[n - r]).mul(invFactorial[r]);
    }

    static Modular binom(int a, int b) {
        return factorial[a + b].mul(invFactorial[a]).mul(invFactorial[b]);
    }

    static Modular catalanNumber(int n) {
        Modular result = binom(n, n);
        if (n - 1 >= 0) {
            result = result.sub(binom(n - 1, n + 1));
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void process() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        Modular.MOD = sc.nextInt();
        initFactorials();

        Modular answer = new Modular(0);
        for (int len = 1; len < m; len++) {
            Modular term1 = new Modular(len + 1).power(len).mul(new Modular(len)).div(new Modular(n - len)).mul(invFactorial[len]);
            for (int i = 0; i < m - len; i++) {
                int j = i + len;
                Modular term2 = new Modular(n - len).power(i).mul(invFactorial[i]);
                Modular term3 = new Modular(n - j).mul(new Modular(n + 1).power(m - 1 - j)).mul(factorial[j]);
                answer = answer.add(term1.mul(term2).mul(term3));
            }
        }
        answer = answer.mul(new Modular(2).power(m - 1)).mul(new Modular(n + 1 - m));
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        process();
    }
}
